dissertation.title: Explainable AI for Predicting Malware Infection
dissertation.summary: Developed an interpretable ML pipeline on the Microsoft Malware dataset (8.9M devices) with GDPR-compatible explainability for cybersecurity applications.
bullets: Trained ML model achieving ~66.7% accuracy and ~66.4% recall, aiding proactive mitigation of data breaches and financial risks.
Applied EBM, SHAP, LIME for interpretability, producing local + global explanations with uncertainty for regulatory + trust alignment (GDPR-compatible design).
Engineered features from 4.1GB (83-field) dataset, optimizing memory usage by ~50% via columnar transformations in Pandas/Polars.

education.degree: B.Tech in Computer Science and Engineering

projects.title: FinSight: Enterprise Multi-Agent Investment Intelligence Platform
projects.summary: Architected a multi-agent AI platform for investment research, orchestrating specialized agents for retrieval, quantitative analysis, market intelligence, analytics, and response validation.
bullets: Designed a framework-agnostic agent architecture using Google ADK, LangGraph, LangChain, LlamaIndex, CrewAI, PydanticAI, OpenAI Agents SDK, and the Agent-to-Agent (A2A) Protocol.
Implemented a unified Model Context Protocol (MCP) server exposing structured financial data, SEC filings, and external knowledge sources.
Built hybrid RAG with dense retrieval, BM25 search, reranking, metadata filtering, and persistent conversational memory.
Designed evaluation and observability pipelines using RAGAS and Langfuse to analyze retrieval quality, reasoning performance, hallucinations, and end-to-end system behavior.
Developed the platform using AI coding tools including Claude Code, OpenCode, and Mimo Code.
